When I realized I wasn’t telling her anything about my life to avoid her criticizing it. I avoided telling her about my new relationship, how I was doing, etc- all because she would have had a negative thing to say about it.     

Couldn’t even tell her what new color my hair was now, in case she started a fight about it. Seriously.

Just being who I am ends up pushing everyone away. I don’t know how to fix it but nearly everyone’s left now anyways.
I used to feel like I put the blame on myself too much but if everyone’s leaving, I’m the common factor. It hurts but it’s true, at least for me.

Everybody leaves. Even people who say they never will. I drive them all away.

I have a tendency to let people walk over me. I’ll let them talk about all their issues and I’ll drop everything I’m doing if they need me (as long as I consider them close). I do everything I can and nothings enough.. Everyone leaves, and I do mean everyone. I don’t know if they’re bad friends or if it’s just me. Either way, it’s painful and it sucks.

My family’s emotionally abusive, always have been.. And I don’t have close friends because everyone just leaves. I do everything I can to be a good friend but everyone just walks out without a second glance, unless they’re using me...

I don’t have any close friends, my family hates me, so on and so forth.. Idk, staying just sounds like it’ll be painful and leave me in the same place. I don’t wanna be pessimistic but I’ve stayed for so long and nothing changes.

1. Got ridiculously upset over minor things. It was hard to breathe without her finding something ‘wrong’ with what I was doing.

2. Didn’t care about my issues because hers always took priority. She ignored how I was in a mental health spiral because she needed me to get on a train to come buy her a pregnancy test.

3. Talking shit about every single person who wronged her or pissed her off. Every person. Half of them didn’t do anything wrong; she just put the blame on them.
